title: Bound live credit-admission blocking workers after response timeout
outcome: Keep total HTTP response bounds while preventing retries from accumulating still-running credit-admission blocking workers stalled in filesystem or other noncancellable I/O. Preserve exact authority/durability guards and candidate retry semantics.
acceptance: Credit-admission workers have an explicit live-work bound that includes workers still executing after their response deadline, and surplus requests receive a typed bounded refusal.
A deterministic held-worker regression proves the live bound and safe release/retry, without sleeps, inflated deadlines, false acknowledgement or duplicate admission identities.
